 Meet our tools
 
 
 Productivity software for building efficient workflows
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Timekeeping
 
 
 
 Track your time effortlessly, whether you log hours manually, use a timer, or clock in through a shared kiosk.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Reporting
 
 
 
 Use detailed reports and activity logs to analyze performance, track progress, and make data-driven decisions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Management
 
 
 
 Use one tool to manage operations, from scheduling and approvals to expenses and invoicing
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Communication
 
 
 
 Keep your team connected and organized through focused channels, message threads, and smart notifications.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 File sharing
 
 
 
 Share updates, invite guests, and easily manage your conversations with unlimited message history.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Meetings
 
 
 
 Connect instantly through voice or video, with built-in screen sharing for smoother collaboration in real time.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Task management
 
 
 
 Organize work visually with customizable boards, items, ready-to-use templates, and fields tailored to your workflow.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Team collaboration
 
 
 
 Keep everyone in the loop with real-time comments, file sharing, and smart notifications.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Project tracking
 
 
 
 Get a clear overview of your progress, whether you're scanning board views, tracking activity, or analyzing the summary row.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Organize your entire workflow in one place
 
 
 With 3 integrated tools, the CAKE.com Productivity Suite centralizes time
 tracking, team communication, and project management.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 CAKE.com combines Clockify, Pumble, and Plaky into a single productivity suite
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Workload balancing
 
Balance team workloads and keep projects moving smoothly.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Visual project timelines
 
Plan projects and track progress with dynamic Gantt charts.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Task-specific channels
 
Create dedicated channels for projects and keep discussions clear and productive.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automated timesheets
 
Automate time tracking and reporting to save time and ensure accuracy.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Detailed analytics dashboard
 
Get instant insights into team productivity to pinpoint bottlenecks and make data-driven decisions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified messaging hub
 
Keep messages and files in one platform and enjoy effortless collaboration.

Enterprise-grade security
 
 We ensure the highest security standards through an independent audit by a top
 security firm to make sure information of millions of users worldwide is safe
 and private.
 
 
 Visit our trust center
 
 
 
 
 
 
Bug bounty program
 
 Our platform is under a 24/7 security audit and penetration test performed
 by the people in our bug bounty program. Find a vulnerability, report it,
 and get a reward!
 
 
 Report a security issue
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Compliance & certifications
 
 
 
 
SOC 2 Type II Report
 
 An annual audit that demonstrates our ongoing commitment to security and
 data privacy.
 
 
 Request the report

 The world's best-known standard for information security management
 systems.
